quirks.summary: Portal URL and vendor come from PlanIt's directory; neither the vendor nor any retrieval step has been verified against this portal.
quirks.detail: PlanIt reports scraper_type 'Idox'. That label is a hint, not a finding - it is recorded elsewhere in this skill as stale at one authority and wrong at another. Fingerprint the portal before choosing a recipe, and set portal.vendor_verified when you have.
quirks.workaround: Run the vendor detection signatures in vendors.json against the portal before applying any recipe.

quirks.summary: Authority abolished 1 April 2023; functions transferred to North Yorkshire Council.
quirks.detail: The portal hostname no longer resolves because the council no longer exists. The profile is kept so the old name still resolves to an answer - directories including PlanIt continue to list it, and users type historic names.

browser_route.note: This authority was abolished on 1 April 2023. Its applications are now on North Yorkshire Council's register - go there.

verification.note: DNS does not resolve; authority abolished 1 April 2023, succeeded by North Yorkshire Council.
